<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_state(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    pp={(r,c) for r in range(14,40) for c in range(14,44) if L[r][c]=='p' and (r,c) not in cont}
    if not pp: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in pp]; cs=[c for r,c in pp]
    return (len(pp),min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
base=piece_state(current_frame)
print('start',base)
for a in ['UP','DOWN','RIGHT']:
    action([a])
    st=piece_state(current_frame)
    chg = st!=base
    print(a,'->',st,'changed' if chg else 'no-op')
    if chg: base=st
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_state(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    pp={(r,c) for r in range(14,40) for c in range(14,44) if L[r][c]=='p' and (r,c) not in cont}
    if not pp: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in pp]; cs=[c for r,c in pp]
    return (len(pp),min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
base=piece_state(current_frame)
print('start',base)
for a in ['UP','DOWN','RIGHT']:
    action([a])
    st=piece_state(current_frame)
    chg = st!=base
    print(a,'->',st,'changed' if chg else 'no-op')
    if chg: base=st
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
